entities.name: RRCReconfiguration
entities.description: RRC message used to reconfigure UE connection parameters

entities.name: ConditionalReconfiguration
entities.description: Procedure where RRCReconfiguration is stored and applied when conditions are met

entities.name: SCG failure information procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated to report SCG reconfiguration error

entities.name: Connection re-establishment procedure
entities.description: Procedure to re-establish RRC connection after failure

entities.name: Actions upon going to RRC_IDLE
entities.description: Procedure to transition UE to RRC_IDLE state with specified release cause

entities.name: UE unable to comply with configuration
entities.description: Condition where UE cannot apply (part of) the configuration in RRCReconfiguration message

entities.name: UE in (NG)EN-DC
entities.description: Condition indicating UE is operating in (NG)EN-DC dual connectivity mode

entities.name: RRCReconfiguration received via NR
entities.description: Condition where RRCReconfiguration is received in NR standalone, NE-DC, or NR-DC

entities.name: RRCReconfiguration received via other RAT
entities.description: Condition where RRCReconfiguration is received during handover to NR from other RAT

entities.name: MCG transmission not suspended
entities.description: Condition indicating Master Cell Group transmission is active

entities.name: AS security not activated
entities.description: Condition where Access Stratum security has not been activated

entities.name: SRB2 and DRB not setup
entities.description: Condition where SRB2 and at least one DRB have not been established

entities.name: Continue using previous configuration
entities.description: UE behavior to maintain configuration used prior to RRCReconfiguration reception or inability detection

relations.description: UE inability to comply with SRB3 configuration triggers SCG failure information procedure
UE inability to comply with SRB1 configuration triggers connection re-establishment procedure
When RRCReconfiguration is part of ConditionalReconfiguration, UE continues using previous configuration
MCG transmission not being suspended guards the initiation of SCG failure information procedure
AS security not being activated triggers transition to RRC_IDLE with release cause 'other'
SRB2 and DRB not being setup triggers transition to RRC_IDLE with release cause 'RRC connection failure'
UE being in (NG)EN-DC guards the inability condition handling for SRB3/SRB1 configurations
RRCReconfiguration received via NR guards the inability condition handling
RRCReconfiguration received via other RAT guards the inability condition handling
